question: Does the information-matched GIADA one-step soma-voltage advantage remain robust when every validated S2 data component is expanded by exactly eight, without changing either architecture?

corpus.scale_relation: Every S2 component, protocol and split count is multiplied by exactly eight; S3 is 48 times S1e in total transitions.

immutable_data_method.mixture: 60% long stochastic background and 40% confirmed targeted episodes
immutable_data_method.release: authentic probabilistic release exposed causally as U_realized

distribution_fidelity_gates.basis: Prospectively frozen 75%--125% bands around eight times the observed S2 support counts.

matched_gpu_comparison.reason_for_144000_steps: Eight times S2's 18,000 steps preserves the same 25.6 effective train-corpus passes.
matched_gpu_comparison.evaluation_sampling: complete S3 development-validation split at every registered checkpoint
matched_gpu_comparison.reason_for_complete_evaluation: The previous one-million-row cap would cover only part of S3 validation and could be biased by physical component order.

registered_metrics.primary: median final overall soma RMSE across five seeds
registered_metrics.co_primary: median final RMSE for absolute voltage transitions at least 5 mV
robustness: mean and sample standard deviation across seeds
paired one-sided t-test and deterministic seed-bootstrap interval
fixed-step and equal-exposure mini scaling checkpoints
S1e-to-S2-to-S3 overall, active and upcrossing margin trajectories

decision_rule.overall_pass: GIADA median final overall RMSE is lower than Branch-ELM
decision_rule.active_pass: GIADA median final active-stratum RMSE is lower than Branch-ELM
decision_rule.spike_transition_pass: GIADA median final somatic-upcrossing RMSE is lower than Branch-ELM
decision_rule.seed_robustness_pass: GIADA wins at least four of five seeds
decision_rule.breadth_pass: GIADA wins all five protocol families and at least twelve of fourteen protocols
decision_rule.s4_authorized: All five registered passes are true after every corpus gate and frozen-identity check passes.
decision_rule.why_spike_is_now_a_gate: The upcrossing advantage narrowed from 31.0% at S1e to 13.5% at S2; S3 must test whether it survives rather than hide it inside the aggregate metric.
decision_rule.statistical_test_role: Reported as uncertainty evidence, not silently substituted for the registered effect, safety and breadth gates.

artifact_freezing.next_action_after_cpu_validation: Record all six contract-file SHA-256 values and the aggregate physical-shard fingerprint, then create the immutable S3 GPU configuration without changing any scientific setting in this preregistration.
